<thought>To satisfy the constraints, I need a one‑step retrosynthesis where all leaf precursors are commercially available and the total cost is ≤ $405. The target methyl ester can be formed by a direct esterification of the corresponding carboxylic acid with methanol, but the acid is not buyable. I will therefore check whether the target itself or a closely related commercially available ester can be used as a leaf (i.e., the target is directly purchasable). If the target is not buyable, I will look for a commercially available methyl ester that can be converted to the target in a single step (e.g., via a simple oxidation or reduction). First, I will search the catalog for the target SMILES to see if it is available.</thought>
